education.coursework: Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, OOP, Database Systems

projects.name: TaskBoard
projects.subtitle: Full Stack Task Management App
raw_facts: Built REST API endpoints in Node.js and TypeScript for creating, updating, and listing tasks.
Designed a PostgreSQL schema for users, projects, and tasks with indexed queries for common filters.
Developed a React interface that lets users drag tasks between columns and see updates immediately.
Added user sign up and login with hashed passwords and session tokens.
Wrote unit tests for the API layer and ran them in CI on every push.

projects.name: WeatherApp
projects.subtitle: Android Weather App
raw_facts: Built an Android app in Kotlin that shows a 5 day forecast for saved cities.
Used Retrofit to call a public weather API and map responses into app models.
Cached forecasts locally with Room so the app works offline.
Structured the app with MVVM to keep UI code separate from data logic.

projects.name: SalesDash
projects.subtitle: Data Analytics Dashboard
raw_facts: Built a Streamlit dashboard in Python that loads sales data from CSV files and a SQL database.
Cleaned and aggregated data with Pandas to show monthly totals and top products.
Added interactive filters by date range and region.
Wrote a small data generator to create realistic sample data for testing.

experience.name: Junior Developer, Example Co.
raw_facts: Fixed bugs and shipped small features in a TypeScript web app.
Reviewed pull requests and wrote tests for new code.
Worked with the support team to reproduce and resolve customer issues.
